infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to protect access to your OPSIQO employee account.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OPSIQO uses your location only when you submit a governed attendance event such as clock in or clock out.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Use Face ID to protect access to your OPSIQO employee account.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow OPSIQO Employee to use your location only when you submit an attendance event.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow OPSIQO Employee to attach receipt or attendance evidence selected by you.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow OPSIQO Employee to take receipt or attendance evidence photos selected by you.
